sentences.en: I like to decorate my apartment to suit my taste.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢按照自己的品味装饰我的公寓。

sentences.en: The figures and grotesque masks decorating the modillions are interesting.
sentences.zh: 檐部上的那些雕像和怪诞面具令人感兴趣，它们被用来装饰。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever decorated my house.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次自己装修房子。
